behavior.empty_inputs: Null, empty and unbound inputs omit their own Mustache sections. Missing Answer hides entry and hints without throwing.
behavior.accepted_answers:
Each rendered array item is one complete transcript alternative. Word matching selects a consistent transcript; a mixture of incompatible alternatives cannot pass. Array boundaries are read from existing DOM
nodes. Only template JavaScript tokenizes words.
behavior.normalization: NFC and case insensitive. Boundary punctuation is supplied by the transcript and optional when typing; accents, tone marks, internal apostrophes and internal hyphens remain significant.
behavior.character_count: One small dash per Unicode grapheme inside a word, with ordinary spaces between words. One button per word, no separate character boxes. The long passage scrolls within a bounded height and one small input edits the active word.
behavior.hints: Reveal one grapheme of the active word per click through its final character. Hints do not fill the input or mark a word correct.
behavior.audio: No autoplay. Dictation plays on the front only on click; other templates expose native controls on the back.
behavior.back: Compact reference layout: word and answer first, examples paired with their translation. No correctness verdict. Optional sections hide independently, including empty groups.
behavior.grading: Flip the card and choose the study rating.
behavior.keyboard: Space, Enter or Commit word submits the current word and advances. Exact words reveal live; submitted mistakes show red x characters. Click a word to restore its typed text for correction. Backspace in an empty editor goes to the previous word. IME composition never submits; paste supports multiple words.
behavior.correction: After correcting a word, move to the next unfinished word. Extra words stay visible and incorrect until removed. Reset starts the transcript again. Completing every word of one accepted transcript shows success; hints alone cannot complete it.
